question: _________ is the difference between the government's total expenditure and its total receipts, excluding borrowing.
solution:
The correct answer is** the Fiscal deficit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• difference between total revenue and total expenditure of the government 
 
• an indication of the total borrowings needed by the government.
 
• While calculating the total revenue, borrowings are not included.

**​Hence, f**iscal deficit is the difference between total receipts and total expenditure.

1d
